policy.VERIFIED_FOR_CURRENT_VERSION: Explicit current-version proof or practical test covering the whole claim. Critical rules require independent corroboration and all missable/difficulty/one-run clauses.
policy.SUPPORTED_FOR_CURRENT_VERSION: Positive objective/source convergence or a version-neutral precaution; no unlock guarantee. Historical compatibility alone is not VERIFIED.
policy.VERSION_UNCERTAIN: Whole claim lacks current-version proof, even if a component is observed or supported.
policy.DISPUTED: Unresolved contradictory claims; source quality differences recorded; no safe-deferral claim.
